relevant_chat.message: Alright, let's get this started. I'll take the spot on the 6-8-11. Bob, I'm still keeping an eye on you after that stunt you pulled last time. Charlie, I haven't forgotten the warning, even if you did take that trade.
Fresh game, Alice! Let's just see where the dice take us this time. No hard feelings, right?
I'll take the spot on the 3-5-6. It looks like a nice, quiet neighborhood for a charming guy like me, wouldn't you say, Alice?
We'll see how quiet it stays once the robber starts moving, Bob.
Just setting up a little path here. No need to worry, Alice, I'm staying well out of your way for now!
Smart move, Charlie. Probably wise to stay out of the splash zone while Bob tries to convince me he's being neighborly.
Can't blame you, Charlie. It's much more peaceful down there!
I'll take the scenic route down by the fields at 43. All that wheat should keep me busy while you two keep an eye on each other.
Just going to tuck this road in toward the coast. A little fresh air and a view of the sea never hurt anyone, right?
I think I'll take this spot by the mountains. I'm going to need a bit more than just wood and brick if I'm going to keep up with Bob's 'scenic' wheat empire.
Fair enough, Alice. Just looking out for everyone's interests—including my own. That 6-11 is a solid start.
I'll take the 5-9-10 down here. A bit of distance from you two might be for the best, given how things ended last time.
Gotta make sure I have a clear path to expand. That 42 direction looks like it'll open up some good options later on.
I'll take the 8-3-4 up here. I definitely need some wood if I'm going to keep up with you two, and it keeps me from getting totally boxed in down south.
Heading toward the coast. A little sea breeze and some port access should keep things interesting.
A little port access should help balance things out later. It's good to have options when the dice don't go your way.
